items.title: Ramsey Lewis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I’ve been hearing about them for a long time.

ctx.x: Tri-Lateral Commission. Yeah, I’ve been hearing about them for a long time. So you’re saying that there’s a group bigger and more powerful and with more money than the Buffets and that group.
I would say that the Warren Buffets and the George Soroses are hugely outnumbered by people who are into gain, profit, and at whatever expense.

That’s what I’m saying. If the Buffets – if they’re up here with their power and money, there are people down in the system that, even though they may have – maybe they only have hundreds of millions rather than billions . . .
